title: Unity of Being (Wahdat al-Wujud) & The Imaginal Realm
summary: Ibn Arabi's non-dual ontology holding that there is only one true Reality and Existence (Wujud). All contingent things are determinations and reflections (tajalli) of this single divine principle, mediated through the intermediate imaginal realm ('alam al-mithal) where meanings take shape and bodies spiritualize.
